candidate_evidence.quote: This trial is designed to evaluate safety and explore possible efficacy of 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (5-ALA HCl, Gliolan®) with CV01 delivery of ultrasound for sonodynamic therapy
Anti-tumor activity assessed by Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against IBA1 and Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against Caspase III

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients With Newly Diagnosed High-Grade Glioma (HGG) Prior to Resection and Standard Adjuvant Therapy

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Anti-tumor activity assessed by Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against IBA1 and Number of cells / mm³ with antibodies against Caspase III

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive sonodynamic therapy (5 ALA combined with CV01-delivered sonication) 2 to 5 days prior to standard resection.

agents.drug_class_hint: photo/sonosensitiser (porphyrin precursor) used for sonodynamic therapy

coder_notes: Drug-device therapy: 5-ALA with ultrasound (CV01) sonodynamic therapy before resection; standard radio-/chemotherapy follows resection and is not part of the experimental arm, so regimen coded monotherapy. Caspase III / IBA1 staining on resected tissue is a tissue pharmacodynamic/activity readout, coded target_engagement yes (judgement call). No molecular biomarker mentioned.
